item.title: Huff scores 21 in West Virginia’s 74-67 comeback win over UCF
item.description: ORLANDO, Fla. — Honor Huff scored 21 points as West Virginia mounted a comeback from a 14-point second half deficit to beat UCF, 74-67, on Saturday.

item.title: Bhatia’s big birdie runs helps him beat the wind and lead at Pebble Beach
item.description: PEBBLE BEACH, Calif. — Akshay Bhatia played Pebble Beach by the book in accommodating weather with such a blistering start that he threatened to run away with the tournament by building a five-shot lead at the turn.

item.title: Suspect shot by police during standoff in Lower Burrell
item.description: One person was flown to a Pittsburgh hospital after being shot during an exchange of gunfire with police in Lower Burrell.

item.title: Brazil’s first Winter Games gold is about much more than the medal
item.description: RIO DE JANEIRO — With Brazil entering the joyous throes of Carnival, Alpine ski racer Lucas Pinheiro Braathen on Saturday gave it another reason to celebrate: an Olympic medal.

item.title: Poulin scores in return, Canada beats Germany 5-1 in women’s hockey quarterfinal
item.description: MILAN — Marie-Philip Poulin’s injured right knee held up just fine.

item.title: Minor league report: Penguins shut out by Crunch
item.description: Goaltender Sergei Murashov made 24 saves on 29 shots for the Wilkes-Barre/Scranton Penguins in a 5-0 loss to the Syracuse Crunch at Mohegan Arena in Wilkes-Barre on Saturday.

item.title: Heat’s Keshad Johnson soars to a slam dunk title, edging Carter Bryant who had a perfect score
item.description: INGLEWOOD, Calif. — Keshad Johnson of the Miami Heat won the Slam Dunk contest at NBA All-Star Saturday, overcoming perfect scores by San Antonio rookie Carter Bryant on his first dunk in the final round.

item.title: Padres sign ex-Phillies slugger Nick Castellanos, pitchers Canning and Márquez, AP source says
item.description: The San Diego Padres agreed to terms with outfielder Nick Castellanos and right-handers Griffin Canning and Germán Márquez, a person with knowledge of the deals told the Associated Press on Saturday.

item.title: Clash winner Ryan Preece leads Ford top-5 sweep in final Daytona 500 practice
item.description: DAYTONA BEACH, Fla. — Clash winner Ryan Preece kept his Ford on the ground Saturday, and the manufacturer took the top five spots in the final Daytona 500 practice. Preece helped RFK Racing sweep the top three spots a day ahead of NASCAR’s season-opening race.

item.title: NBA’s Adam Silver to consider changing draft lottery, revoking picks to stop teams from tanking
item.description: INGLEWOOD, Calif. — NBA commissioner Adam Silver believes teams are tanking more aggressively this season than the league has seen in recent years, and he is considering many possible remedies to ensure real competition, from taking away draft picks to making wholesale changes to the draft and the lottery.
